scope: Unauthenticated, bounded public GET proof for City of Taylor CivicPlus NewsFlash categories 30 and 31 and archive enumeration/revision identity. No adapter or registry code was changed.

declared_archive_window.date_semantics: Observed archive table returns Published Date and Archived Date; returned archived revisions include older publication dates and Archived Date values within the requested interval. Treat the filter as archive/revision date and preserve both displayed dates separately.
declared_archive_window.enumeration: GET /m/NewsFlash/Archive?archCc=2&startDate=2026-08-01&endDate=2026-09-28&count=10&skip=N. archCc=2, date inputs, count options 10/25/50, skip values, page bounds, total, and disabled Next Page were observed in the official archive HTML controls. Follow observed links only. The filter returns all archived items; inspect each detail's category label before assigning it to category 30 or 31.
declared_archive_window.completeness_stop_rule: For a crawl, retain original response bytes and hashes for every page; require each page to report a consistent total, expected page bounds with no gaps or overlaps, and the terminal page range to end at total with Next Page disabled. Increase skip by the selected count. Re-fetch the first page or repeat the bounded sweep and compare total plus the ordered (article_id, arc_id) set; on drift, missing range, malformed page, or unstable replay, mark the run incomplete/UNKNOWN and retry from the fixed window. No server-side snapshot token was observed, so this proves stable client-side enumeration, not atomic database snapshot isolation.

observed_result.page_2: 11-13 of 13 at skip=10; Next Page and Last Page disabled

example_revision_identity.observed_change: Same article ID and title family; arcId 3434 has the non-WITHDRAWN title and arcId 3442 has WITHDRAWN in its title. Distinct arcId is the revision key; hash canonical response bytes to detect replay equality or changed content.

retrievals.observed: Official category 30 page; rendered response contains linked article IDs and category labels.
Official category 31 page; rendered response exposes article detail links /m/NewsFlash/Home/Detail/{numeric-id}.
Archive page exposes startDate/endDate filters, category/item mode, count options, skip-based pagination, page ranges, total, and terminal disabled controls.
Observed category archive link from the root; response identifies archived Development Notices and original publication interval.
First page has 10 rows; total is 13. Archive rows expose article and arcId links, Published Date, and Archived Date.
Second page reports 11-13 of 13 and disables Next Page and Last Page.

Archived revision's title omits WITHDRAWN; its category label is Development Notices. The later arcId=3442 response with a changed title is retained in GL3-015A evidence and cited in the comparison above.

identity_and_replay.article_identity: Stable source article URL/id (numeric article id), correlated with case number when present; category pages link /m/NewsFlash/Home/Detail/{id}.
identity_and_replay.revision_identity: Archive item link includes arcId; preserve the pair (article_id, arcId) as distinct source revision identity. Archive changes can update title/status while article_id stays constant.
identity_and_replay.replay_rule: Same article_id + arcId + identical raw-byte SHA-256 is byte-identical replay. Same pair with changed bytes is a changed retrieval and must be retained as a new observed version/health event pending review; a different arcId is an upstream revision even when title/body appear equivalent.
identity_and_replay.limitations: No ETag, Last-Modified, documented API schema, stable snapshot token, or published retention/latency contract was validated in this probe. Do not infer item ordering beyond observed UI, and do not treat category roots as an exhaustive history.

public_and_legal_limits.access: Only direct unauthenticated HTTPS GET requests to public taylortx.gov HTML pages; no credentials, account, paid service, form submission, or non-public endpoint used.
public_and_legal_limits.reuse: This probe establishes technical public retrieval only. It does not determine copyright, terms-of-use, robots policy, or permission for bulk republication. Keep stored extracts factual and attributed; obtain legal review for wider republication or materially increased collection.
public_and_legal_limits.cost: No fee or request limit was presented during these GETs; network/compute cost was not measured. No polling cadence is claimed.
